subject: CHEMISTRY
purpose: No learner-facing question without a checkable answer path. Every question a learner meets — Core 1 practice included, not only Core 2 transfer — resolves to an explicit immediate answer check AND a full worked solution or rubric. A hint is never an answer path. The vocabulary here is deliberately identical to the Physics answer-custody invariant so the two subjects stay comparable.

answer_path_kinds.CLOSED_OPTION: A single correct option label. The immediate check names the option; the full solution shows why.
answer_path_kinds.CLOSED_VALUE: A single value with its unit, or a single formula. The immediate check gives that value; the full solution shows the method.
answer_path_kinds.OPEN_RESPONSE: No single answer exists. The immediate check lists the required marking points and an expected-response rubric is mandatory.

immediate_check_rules: Compact enough not to become a second solution.
On a learner surface separate from the question, so the learner can attempt first.
Derived from the already-authored solution route; never independently invented.

baseline_reconciliation.note: The four PR #346 topic baselines already satisfy this invariant by hand. The machine check is reconciled against their real recorded counts so it is proved against authored content rather than only against a fixture.

known_limitations: Core 1 practice items are authored open-response instances, so their answer path is an expected-response rubric rather than a single value. That is the correct custody for an open item, but it means the Core 1 side of the invariant is checked as open_response_total == rubrics_total; it does not assert that a single closed answer exists, because one does not.

The #346 baseline reconciliation is against the recorded per-topic counts in HANDOFF_MANIFEST.json. It cannot be re-derived per question from that branch, because #346's committed source bundle does not reconstruct (see chemistry-source-ingestion-profile.json known_limitations).
